cases.question: When is Mosslight open, and which days is it closed?
cases.reference: Mosslight is open Tuesday through Saturday from 09:30 to 17:30 and is closed on Sunday and Monday.
evidenceHints: open Tuesday through Saturday from 09:30 to 17:30

cases.question: When is the safety induction, how long does it last, and how many people can attend?
cases.reference: The safety induction starts every Thursday at 18:00, lasts 45 minutes, and permits at most eight participants.

cases.question: According to Mosslight's loan rules, how many tools may one member borrow at once, and how many calendar days is the standard loan period?
cases.reference: A member may borrow no more than two tools at once for a standard period of seven calendar days.
evidenceHints: no more than two tools at once
standard loan period is seven calendar days

cases.question: When does the repair cafe run, and which appliance will volunteers not repair?
cases.reference: The repair cafe runs from 10:00 to 12:00 on the first Saturday of each month, and volunteers do not repair microwave ovens.
evidenceHints: first Saturday of each month from 10:00 to 12:00

cases.question: What is the rainwater tank capacity, and what may its water be used for?
cases.reference: The tank holds 2,400 litres. Its water may be used for the teaching garden and cleaning outdoor tools, but not for drinking.
evidenceHints: used for the teaching garden and for cleaning outdoor tools

cases.question: At what times does the minibus stop at Elm Gate, and how can bicycles be carried?
cases.reference: On workshop days the minibus stops at Elm Gate at 09:10 and 14:10; bicycles may be carried only on the rear rack.
evidenceHints: bicycles may be carried only on the rear rack

cases.question: How many workshop tokens does one reclaimed plywood sheet cost at Mosslight?
cases.reference: One reclaimed plywood sheet costs three workshop tokens.
evidenceHints: reclaimed plywood sheets for three workshop tokens each

cases.question: How long can one member reserve the quiet design room consecutively, and may food be brought inside?
cases.reference: Reservations use 30-minute blocks and are limited to two consecutive blocks, so one member may reserve one hour; food is not allowed.
